response.justification: Bogdan Szabo is a talented full-stack developer with broad experience across web, mobile, and open-source projects, but this profile is fundamentally misaligned with the role's core requirements. The position mandates 5–10 years of strong C++ development on Windows; the resume shows only approximately 6 months of C++ work (at National Instruments, 2014–2015). Additionally, there is zero demonstrated experience in capital markets, fixed income, or investment banking—requirements that cannot be substituted given the lack of deep C++ expertise. SQL experience is minimal and focused on modern web stacks (MongoDB, Node.js) rather than SQL Server or Oracle.
strengths: Extensive software engineering background spanning 16+ years across diverse platforms and domains, demonstrating strong problem-solving ability
Solid CI/CD and DevOps expertise including GitLab administration, Docker, and deployment infrastructure—directly applicable to financial systems environments
Excellent communication and knowledge-sharing demonstrated through multiple workshops, technical talks, and active open-source contributions
concerns: Critically deficient in mandatory C++ requirement: only ~6 months of documented C++ experience versus required 5–10 years; recent roles (2015–present) focus on TypeScript, Node.js, and web technologies
Complete absence of required domain expertise: no capital markets, fixed income, investment banking, or financial derivatives experience; background is web, mobile, GIS, and open-source development

Limited SQL and enterprise database background: no evidence of SQL Server or Oracle experience; career primarily utilizes modern web stacks (MongoDB, JavaScript ecosystems) rather than traditional enterprise databases

key_factors.factor: Missing Capital Markets / Fixed Income Domain
